notes: NEW: EXERCISES — a step-by-step theory and ear-training course, now the first thing you see. Five topics (Notes, Intervals, Chords, Scales, Key signatures), each split into units you can practice on the staff (treble and bass, real engraved notation), on the piano, on the fretboard, by ear, or as theory questions. 141 levels of 10 questions: 8 right passes, 9 or 10 earns more stars, and the notes you miss come up more often. Answer by tapping, pressing 1-9, or PLAYING it on your MIDI keyboard, the on-screen keys, or your guitar via Tone-in. LATENCY: the master limiter (which delayed every note by about 6 ms) is replaced by a zero-delay soft clipper; sample analysis moves to load time; the audio device warms up on your first tap; mouse clicks on the neck sound on press; and MIDI notes now sound before the screen redraws. If a MIDI keyboard plays before you have tapped the page, a hint explains that the browser needs one tap to turn sound on. NOTE: this update is live on web/desktop/PWA immediately; the Android APK build lags until the next PC build.
